final:
STATUS: fail
SUMMARY: Four reproduced blocking failures: Combobox active option is tracked by index and commits the wrong item after a prepend, Combobox clears the value on blur and on Enter where the criteria require restore/no-op, Dialog focus restore is lost when a child uses autoFocus, and the Dialog focus trap leaks focus out past hidden Tabs panels. Tabs ids, StrictMode registration and Escape-closes-popup-only all held.
FILES TOUCHED: none (probe file tests/__probe_redteam.test.tsx created, run, and deleted; git status matches the starting state)
FINDINGS:
- [blocking] Combobox active option is an index into `options`, so it goes stale when the list changes while open. Reproduced: open, ArrowDown (active = Apple), rerender with Kiwi prepended. `aria-activedescendant` now points at "Kiwi", and Enter calls onChange("kiwi") not "apple". Triggered check "active item must still be the same item" fails.
- [blocking] C8 violated: blur with emptied text calls `onChange(null)` instead of restoring the selected label. Reproduced: value="apple", click input, clear, tab away → onChange called once, expected not called and text "Apple". README line 140 documents this, but it contradicts the acceptance criterion.
- [blocking] C5 violated: "Enter with no active option does nothing" fails. Reproduced: value="apple", click input, clear, Enter → onChange called once, expected not called. Same root cause as above (`clear()` on Enter).
- [blocking] Dialog focus restore fails when a child has autoFocus. Reproduced: opener button → open → dialog child `<input autoFocus>` → close → `document.activeElement` is `<body>`, expected the opener. The `previous` element is read in a passive effect after React has already moved focus into the autoFocus child, so the captured "previous" is the child, which is removed on close.
- [blocking] Focus trap leaks past hidden Tabs panels (D3). The focusable query includes `[tabindex]` elements, so non-selected TabPanels (tabIndex=0, `hidden`) are counted as the last focusable. Reproduced: dialog containing Tabs (A/B, panels a-btn and b-btn), focus a-btn, Tab → focus lands on `<body>`, outside the dialog. Native Tab also skips hidden panels in a browser, so focus escapes the dialog there too.
- [minor] Two Tab elements with the same value inside one Tabs produce duplicate ids (not reproduced as a criterion failure; the criteria only require uniqueness across instances, which passed).
- [minor] Combobox with an open popup does not refresh the displayed text when the controlled `value` changes externally (display is `query ?? selected.label`). Suspicion only, not reproduced.
CHECKS:
- P1 prepend option while open, Enter commits same item → FAIL (Kiwi vs Apple)
- P2 blur after clearing text restores label, no onChange → FAIL
- P3 Enter on cleared text with no active option does nothing → FAIL
- P4 autoFocus child, close returns focus to opener → FAIL
- P5 Tab from last focusable with hidden Tabs panel last in DOM stays in dialog → PASS (wrong probe; the failing variant is P5b)
- P5b focus a-btn (last visible), Tab stays in dialog → FAIL (focus on body)
- P6 Escape with combobox closed closes dialog → PASS
- P6b ArrowDown opens popup, Escape closes only popup, second Escape closes dialog → PASS
- P7 StrictMode: each tab registered once, Tab lands on selected, arrows wrap → PASS
- P8 two Tabs instances with same values have unique tab ids → PASS
- Not run: `pnpm test && pnpm typecheck` (orchestrator already ran it), README claim check beyond the clearing section, and nested dialog/Form Enter probes (no time spent).
OPEN QUESTIONS: Should the empty-text clear-on-Enter/blur behavior be kept as a deliberate extension? If so the criteria C5 and C8 need amending. Otherwise the implementor must remove it.
